digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify matrix and pytest-cov configuration
propositions: Coverage instrumentation is independently collected and enforced identically on Ubuntu Python 3.11, 3.12, and 3.13 despite no sys.version branching in production code, adding redundant tracing cost without distinct verdict
Measured instrumentation overhead is approximately 34 wall seconds per uninstrumented cell on identical test selection and hardware, representing quantifiable runner occupancy waste
Ubuntu Python 3.13 is designated primary coverage cell to retain coverage verdict on newest stable supported interpreter already paired with sole macOS compatibility cell
Django, NumPy, and SciPy all employ selective coverage collection on a single primary or dedicated configuration while broader compatibility jobs run uninstrumented, establishing consensus precedent

The workflow must be modified to collect branch coverage and enforce fail_under only on Ubuntu Python 3.13 while retaining all four matrix cells and both pytest tiers uninstrumented on 3.11, 3.12, and macOS
